messages:
alex_kim: Heads-up 1: Priya at DataSignals just sent a last-minute request: push embargo by 3 hours and remove a comparative line from the quote. Need quick triage.

sam_pr: Who's on the call?

alex_kim: It's just a 1:1 briefing but we had the analyst list prepped. She DM'd a redline.

maria_product: can you paste the redline?

alex_kim: pasted: 
```
Please remove: \"costs 2x less than incumbent\". Also shift embargo to 2026-04-15 12:00 PT (was 09:00 PT). Will confirm final slot by EOD.
```

jordan_legal: Agreed remove the comparative. Also we should drop any explicit SLA line unless we include terms. I'll draft neutral language.

sam_pr: We need an approved one-liner for the press kit without competitive claims. Can product/legal give options now?

maria_product: options: 
- \"Redwood Inference delivers predictable, low-latency LLM serving across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments.\"
- \"Our platform helps teams reduce inference cost while maintaining production-grade latency and reliability.\"

jordan_legal: Legal prefers: \"Redwood Inference enables engineering teams to run production LLMs with predictable performance and strong operational controls.\" That avoids unverified comparisons.

sam_pr: Good. I'll use that as the official quote. Olivia, can you update the press kit embargo and mailing schedule?

olivia_ops: Will do. If embargo becomes 12:00 PT, note this bumps our webinar/demo timeline. We can move the recording to 15:30 PT if needed and adjust the follow-up send window. I'll update the CDN purge webhook to publish at 12:00 PT.

pressbot: [auto] Calendar invite updated: Analyst briefing (Priya, DataSignals) proposed time 2026-04-15 12:00 PT.

alex_kim: Priya replied: can do 12:30 PT but wants embargo at 12:00 unchanged. Is that ok?

sam_pr: We normally keep embargo until briefing end, but okay if kit goes live at 12:00 and we advise reporters on the call. Ops confirm publish schedule.

olivia_ops: Confirmed: press kit publish + CDN purge at 12:00 PT. We'll mute the recording until 12:30 if the briefing starts later. Regional routing set so APAC contacts aren't triggered at odd hours.

maria_product: For the briefing, Priya wants a short benchmark section on latency/throughput across sequence lengths and a note on caching/batching. I'll prepare 2 slides.

jordan_legal: Add a footnote about benchmark conditions: hardware, sequence length profile, and quantization settings. I'll review the slide text.

maria_product: Draft footnote: \"Benchmark measured on Dedicated GPUs; results vary by hardware, sequence length distribution, and quantization/profile settings.\"

ajordan_legal: small edit: \"Customers may observe different results depending on hardware and configuration\". Approving once updated.

alex_kim: Action checklist:
- update quote to legal-approved line (sam)
- press kit embargo -> 2026-04-15 12:00 PT (olivia)
- confirm briefing time with Priya 12:30 PT (alex/olivia)
- add benchmark footnote to slides (maria)
- legal sign-off on slide copy (jordan)
- schedule newsroom publish + CDN purge (olivia)

sam_pr: I'll send the updated invite/email to the analyst pool with the approved quote and embargo.

alex_kim: Priya also asked for a short FAQ on privacy and on-prem options for enterprise readers.

maria_product: Draft FAQ: \"Redwood Private offers VPC and on-prem deployment options with customer-managed networking and KMS/HSM integrations. Customers can configure data isolation and retention controls; audit logs are available.\"

jordan_legal: tweak: replace any implied defaults with \"customers can configure\" phrasing.

maria_product: updated in the shared briefing doc. link: https://docs.redwood.ai/briefings/faq-priya (internal)

sam_pr: Sending now. Will post back when sent.

alex_kim: Note for future: try to lock embargo + quote 48h prior to calls to avoid last-minute redlines.

sam_pr: Agreed. Sent. :rocket:
